advantages: Read and write sides scale independently
Reconstruction of any data room's state at any point in time
disadvantages: Large event histories add operational complexity

components.name: BrowserSPA
responsibilities: Browser-based UI sending Commands to Command API
Browser-based UI issuing Queries to Query API
Client-side E2E encryption and decryption with SecuPass key

components.name: CommandAPI
responsibilities: Accept mutating commands: UploadFile, CreateRoom, GrantAccess, RevokeAccess, DeleteFile
Authenticate and authorise each command
Route validated commands to the Command Bus

components.name: CommandBus
responsibilities: Delivery of commands to their respective Command Handlers

components.name: FileCommandHandler
responsibilities: Process UploadFile, DeleteFile, MoveFile, RenameFile commands
Validates domain invariants: file size ≤ 100 GB, room capacity
Writes resulting domain events: FileUploaded, FileDeleted, FileMoved
Triggers virus scanner before emitting FileUploaded event

components.name: RoomCommandHandler
responsibilities: Process CreateRoom, DeleteRoom, RenameRoom, SetDeletionDeadline commands
Enforce that only room owners can delete/configure rooms
Write RoomCreated, RoomDeleted, RoomRenamed, DeletionDeadlineSet events to Event Store

components.name: AccessCommandHandler
responsibilities: Process GrantAccess, RevokeAccess, ChangeRole, InviteUser commands
Write AccessGranted, AccessRevoked, RoleChanged, UserInvited events to Event Store

components.name: AuditEventStore
responsibilities: Immutable storage of all domain events in sequence

components.name: ProjectionEngine
responsibilities: Subscription to the live event feed from the Event Store
Maintain multiple denormalized read models
Handle out-of-order events

components.name: RoomReadModel
responsibilities: View of data room contents: folder structure, files, metadata, current user permissions
Updated by ProjectionEngine

components.name: AuditReadModel
responsibilities: Projection of all audit events per data room
Queryable by data room owners and admins; access-controlled at query layer

components.name: AdminReadModel
responsibilities: Aggregated admin dashboard view
Support storage capacity planning and compliance reporting

components.name: QueryAPI
responsibilities: Serve all read-only queries
Enforce read-side authorisation
Route queries to the appropriate read model store

components.name: NotificationService
responsibilities: Subscribe to domain events
Send email notifications to relevant users

components.name: ObjectStorage
responsibilities: Store encrypted file binary content
Support chunked upload for files up to 100 GB
Data residency enforced in German data centers

components.name: VirusScanner
responsibilities: Reject upload if malware is detected
Record scan result

components.name: IdentityProvider
responsibilities: Provide authentication
Issue tokens consumed by both CommandAPI and QueryAPI

components.name: ExternalMailService
responsibilities: Delivers email invitations, upload notifications, and deletion warnings

infrastructure.name: CommandCluster
infrastructure.details: Stateless Command API and Command Handler instances; scales independently of read side; all nodes write only to the Event Store

infrastructure.name: QueryCluster
infrastructure.details: Stateless Query API instances; scales independently based on read traffic; all queries served from pre-built read model stores

infrastructure.name: EventStorageCluster
infrastructure.details: Durable, ordered, append-only event log with WORM retention; deployed in German data centers; acts as the single source of truth for all domain state

infrastructure.name: ReadModelStores
infrastructure.details: PostgreSQL and OpenSearch instances hosting denormalized read models; rebuilt from Event Store replay if corrupted; restricted to Germany

infrastructure.name: ObjectStorageCluster
infrastructure.details: AES-256 GCM encrypted object storage for file content; supports chunked uploads up to 100 GB; German data center only

infrastructure.name: TLSTermination
infrastructure.details: TLS at load balancer for all client-facing traffic; mTLS between internal services
